description: Loops over a source bitmap table in groups of four words and shifts each group right by a shift count, storing the shifted words into a shifted-copy table. Zero padding is written after each row, and the loop runs over a range of shift amounts.

name: clear_and_build_shifted_rows
description: Clears a long run of words in a fixed buffer with an unrolled sequence of stores, then builds shifted copies of source bitmap rows in groups of four words. Zero padding is written after each row.

name: clear_and_build_shifted_rows
description: Clears the same buffer region with an unrolled sequence of stores, then builds shifted copies of source rows as its neighbour does.

name: clear_and_build_shifted_rows
description: Clears the same buffer region with an unrolled sequence of stores, then builds shifted copies of source rows in the same way as its neighbours.

name: draw_text_glyph_string
description: Draws a string of glyphs from a byte stream until an end marker. Each character selects an eight-row glyph from a table of 32-byte cells and writes its bytes into four bitplane rows, while a line marker moves the output down one line.

name: draw_text_glyph_string_plane
description: Draws a byte-coded string into bitplane words, reading one sixteen-row glyph cell per character until a terminator byte. Each glyph is written with interleaved word copies.

name: draw_text_glyph_string_plane
description: Draws a byte-coded string into bitplane words starting eight rows lower, reading one sixteen-row glyph cell per character until a terminator byte.

name: advance_record_path_frames
description: For each active record whose timer has expired, reads the next entry from a path table chosen by its type. A marker value of 99 deactivates the record; otherwise the entry moves the record's position and advances its step counter.

name: scroll_tile_strip_backward
description: Copies a block of tile rows from a source buffer into the drawing plane at a scroll offset. It steps the offset backwards by fixed amounts and sets a completion flag when the offset reaches zero.

name: scroll_tile_strip_forward
description: Copies a block of tile rows from a source buffer into the drawing plane at a scroll offset. It steps the offset forwards by fixed amounts and sets a completion flag when the offset reaches its limit.

name: copy_fixed_tile_block
description: Copies a fixed block of tile words into a drawing plane, writing four interleaved plane words per source group at fixed row offsets. It runs sixteen bands of twenty groups each.

name: scroll_tile_strip_alternate
description: Copies a block of tile rows at a scroll offset with a different band stride and six words per group. It steps the offset forward until a limit is reached, then sets a completion flag.

name: scroll_tile_strip_alternate_back
description: Repeats the block copy of its neighbour, stepping the scroll offset backwards until its limit, then sets a completion flag.

name: copy_fixed_block_twelve_groups
description: Copies a fixed block of twenty-five bands of twelve groups into a drawing plane at a fixed offset, writing four plane words per group.

name: copy_fixed_block_eight_groups
description: Copies a fixed block of 111 bands of eight groups into a drawing plane at a fixed offset, writing four plane words per group.

name: or_planes_into_mask_buffers
description: Ors the four bitplane words of each source group into one combined word and writes it to several destination rows at fixed offsets. It runs three passes over different source and destination regions. The routine is unreached in the static flow.

name: start_blitter_masked_copy
description: Sets the blitter mask, modulo, control and pointer registers for a masked copy, starts a blit of a fixed size, and waits until the blitter is no longer busy.

name: combine_mask_and_source_planes
description: Loops over eighty-seven rows, ANDing a mask word into four destination plane words and then ORing in source words for each plane. It handles eight source words per row.

name: clear_strided_long_buffer
description: Clears 352 groups of five longwords at a fixed buffer offset, stepping ten longwords per group.

name: step_colors_toward_target
description: On each tick of a countdown, moves each of sixteen colour words one step toward its matching target word, working on the red, green and blue nibbles separately. A second counter advances on each reload.

name: step_colors_toward_target
description: On each tick of a countdown, moves each of eight colour words one step toward its matching target word, working on the red, green and blue nibbles separately. It is the same colour change as its neighbour with a shorter table.

name: copy_five_word_rows
description: Copies ninety-six rows of five words each from a fixed source into a drawing buffer with a fixed stride between rows. It is called by two routines.

name: set_control_state_then_call
description: Writes a control value and clears a shared word, stores the sign of its input, writes a second control value and calls one routine. If the input was negative it enters an endless loop; otherwise it writes a final control value and returns.

name: set_port_bit_then_poll
description: Builds a control port value by shifting a bit chosen from a stored index and setting a flag bit when a second value is non-zero. It writes the value to the control port, then polls a status bit for a bounded count before returning.

name: pulse_control_port_bits
description: Writes six byte values to a control port, each clearing one of five bits in turn and then restoring all bits. It is a fixed sequence of pulses that takes no data input.

name: wait_port_status_then_clear
description: Repeatedly calls one routine while a status bit of the port stays set, then clears a stored word and returns.

name: step_port_toward_target
description: Compares a stored position with the input and, when they differ, updates the stored position and sends one pulse per step toward the target on the control port, with a short delay between pulses. The direction bit depends on the sign of the difference.

name: pulse_port_pairs_with_delay
description: Sends a counted series of pulse pairs to the control port, with a fixed delay after each pulse, using the count from the input register.

name: retry_port_sync_loop
description: Runs a counted loop that calls five routines per pass and retries up to eight times while a check fails. On the last retry it sets a shared byte to 255 before exiting.

name: start_disk_read_with_sync
description: Programs the disk control, length and sync registers for a read, writes the disk sync word, then polls the interrupt status for a bounded count before returning.

name: decode_mfm_sectors_with_sync
description: Scans a track buffer for the disk sync word, decodes the odd and even bits of each sector's data with the alternating-bit mask, copies the decoded bytes to a destination, and accumulates an XOR checksum.

name: start_audio_channel_playback
description: Checks a per-channel status bit in a shared byte. For the first flagged channel it writes that channel's location, length and interrupt enable values, then returns. It handles up to four channels in a fixed order.

name: init_dma_state_and_lookup
description: Clears several DMA-related registers and state words, then looks up an entry in a table selected by the input and computes a pointer from it. It ends with bad instruction data, which is a decompiler artefact.

name: dispatch_table_indirect_call
description: Looks up a value in a table indexed by a sign-adjusted byte, stores the result and a pointer in the state record, then makes an indirect call through a stored routine pointer. The jump table could not be recovered.

name: dispatch_table_indirect_call
description: Repeats the indexed-table dispatch of its neighbour, storing results at other record offsets before an indirect call through a stored routine pointer.

name: dispatch_table_indirect_call
description: Repeats the indexed-table dispatch of its neighbours, storing results at other record offsets before an indirect call. The facts also list a DMA control register touch.

name: tick_counter_then_dispatch
description: Sets a status bit and decrements a counter. While the counter is still non-negative it clears a bit in the record, and the decompiler reports bad instruction data. Otherwise it makes an indirect call through a table entry.

name: clear_selected_bit_in_byte
description: Clears one bit, chosen from the low three bits of a register, in a byte at an offset from the address register. The trailing bad instruction data is a decompiler artefact.

name: store_byte_then_dispatch
description: Stores one source byte into a record field, then makes an indirect call through a table entry selected by the high byte of the input and the next source byte.

name: store_byte_then_dispatch
description: Same as its neighbour: stores one source byte into a different record field before the indirect table call.

name: store_word_then_dispatch
description: Stores a source word into a shared location and a record pointer, then makes an indirect table call selected by the input and the following source byte.

name: store_word_then_dispatch
description: Same as its neighbour, storing the source word into a different record field before the indirect table call.

name: dispatch_byte_table_call
description: Makes a single indirect call through a table entry selected by the high byte of the input and a source byte, with no other work.

name: store_word_pointer_then_dispatch
description: Stores a source word and a pointer to the following source bytes in the record, writes a flag byte, then makes an indirect table call.

name: clear_selected_bit_in_byte
description: Copies a source byte to a shared location, then clears one bit in a byte of the record. The trailing bad instruction data is a decompiler artefact.

name: clear_selected_bit_in_byte
description: Clears one bit after copying the source byte to a shared location, with the same bit-clearing step as its neighbour. The trailing bad instruction data is a decompiler artefact.

name: clear_selected_bit_in_byte
description: Clears one bit, chosen from the low three bits of a register, in a byte at an offset from the address register. The trailing bad instruction data is a decompiler artefact.

name: dispatch_or_reset_state
description: Checks two sign-tested bytes. When both are negative it stores a flag, resets several hardware registers and a shared byte, and returns. Otherwise it stores a table-derived pointer and makes an indirect call.

name: parse_stream_header_and_scan
description: Reads two header bytes from a source stream into the record, sets a status word, then scans following bytes against a threshold and a match value before making one call. The trailing bad instruction data is a decompiler artefact.

name: fill_buffer_from_table_loop
description: Copies bytes from a source table into a buffer, advancing the destination by an offset read from each written byte. The body is an endless loop with no exit.

name: loop_set_byte_on_flag
description: Endless loop that sets a record byte to a fixed value whenever a comparison of the input byte against zero reports the flag as clear.
